invariance de R_g.ESTIMAND: beta = d log(observed / predicted) / d log L, the log-log slope of the arm-level median of Rg after dividing out the operator's exact finite-size prediction at that L
invariance de R_g.ESTIMATOR: weighted least squares slope of y_L = log(mean over arms at L) - log(pred_L) on log L, over the 3 domain sizes; weights w_L = (mean_L / se_L)^2 with se_L = max(sd_realised, sd_prereg) / sqrt(n_L)
invariance de R_g.NULL_HYPOTHESIS: H0 : |beta| >= margin  (NOT equivalent to a constant)
invariance de R_g.UNIT_OF_ANALYSIS: the seed (one arm = one seed); frames are reduced first
invariance de R_g.AGGREGATION_RULE: within a seed: median over the 180 in-window frames; across seeds at one L: arithmetic mean of the arm medians; across L: weighted least squares on log L

invariance de r80.ESTIMAND: beta = d log(observed / predicted) / d log L, the log-log slope of the arm-level median of r80 after dividing out the operator's exact finite-size prediction at that L
invariance de r80.ESTIMATOR: weighted least squares slope of y_L = log(mean over arms at L) - log(pred_L) on log L, over the 3 domain sizes; weights w_L = (mean_L / se_L)^2 with se_L = max(sd_realised, sd_prereg) / sqrt(n_L)
invariance de r80.NULL_HYPOTHESIS: H0 : |beta| >= margin  (NOT equivalent to a constant)
invariance de r80.UNIT_OF_ANALYSIS: the seed (one arm = one seed); frames are reduced first
invariance de r80.AGGREGATION_RULE: within a seed: median over the 180 in-window frames; across seeds at one L: arithmetic mean of the arm medians; across L: weighted least squares on log L

invariance de |C - Y|.ESTIMAND: beta = d log(observed / predicted) / d log L, the log-log slope of the arm-level median of organiser_to_core after dividing out the operator's exact finite-size prediction at that L
invariance de |C - Y|.ESTIMATOR: weighted least squares slope of y_L = log(mean over arms at L) - log(pred_L) on log L, over the 3 domain sizes; weights w_L = (mean_L / se_L)^2 with se_L = max(sd_realised, sd_prereg) / sqrt(n_L)
invariance de |C - Y|.NULL_HYPOTHESIS: H0 : |beta| >= margin  (NOT equivalent to a constant)
invariance de |C - Y|.UNIT_OF_ANALYSIS: the seed (one arm = one seed); frames are reduced first

exposant de densite.ESTIMAND: gamma = d log(N_X / L^2) / d log L
exposant de densite.ESTIMATOR: weighted least squares slope of log(mean density at L) on log L
exposant de densite.AGGREGATION_RULE: within a seed: mean N_X over the in-window frames divided by L^2; across seeds: arithmetic mean; across L: WLS on log L. NOTE: the extinct arm entered this mean with density 0.

winding veritable.ESTIMAND: the probability that the cloud's support carries a non-contractible cycle on the torus, at each L
winding veritable.ESTIMATOR: pooled fraction of in-window frames flagged by the 5x5 tiling lift, over all arms at that L
winding veritable.NULL_HYPOTHESIS: H0 : the winding frequency exceeds the tolerance
winding veritable.CONFIDENCE_LEVEL: none: a deterministic threshold on a pooled frequency
winding veritable.UNIT_OF_ANALYSIS: the FRAME, pooled across seeds — the one place where OBDI01 did not use the seed as the unit. It is defensible only because the observed count is exactly zero, for which no variance model is needed; it would NOT be defensible for a non-zero count.
winding veritable.AGGREGATION_RULE: sum of flagged frames / sum of frames, per L

compatibilite du profil radial.ESTIMAND: the total-variation distance between the pooled empirical radial mass distribution about the organiser and the exact predicted radial distribution of the operator, at each L
compatibilite du profil radial.ESTIMATOR: per arm, TV between the window-pooled empirical radial histogram (16 integer-distance bins) and the DFT-exact relative profile
compatibilite du profil radial.NULL_HYPOTHESIS: H0 : the arm's profile is incompatible with the exact kernel
compatibilite du profil radial.CONFIDENCE_LEVEL: the q99 of an envelope generated from n_eff = 27 independent draws of the exact kernel
compatibilite du profil radial.AGGREGATION_RULE: at each L, at least 4 of the 5 arms must be within the envelope

endpoint historique frac_localized >= 0..COMPONENT: SECONDARY (locked, not part of the region)
endpoint historique frac_localized >= 0..ESTIMAND: the probability that a frame has r80 measured from the organiser at or below min(12.8, 0.35 L)
endpoint historique frac_localized >= 0..ESTIMATOR: per arm, the fraction of in-window frames satisfying it
endpoint historique frac_localized >= 0..EQUIVALENCE_MARGIN: not an equivalence test: a one-sided threshold at 0.95
endpoint historique frac_localized >= 0..UNIT_OF_ANALYSIS: the seed, judged one arm at a time
endpoint historique frac_localized >= 0..AGGREGATION_RULE: reported per arm and counted per L; never aggregated into a verdict

AMBIGUITY_1_FOUR_COMPONENTS.QUESTION: which are the four components, and which one failed?

A_shape_invariance.note: a SINGLE component carrying THREE statistics; it passes only if all three pass

AMBIGUITY_1_FOUR_COMPONENTS.RESOLUTION: 'three components out of four' is exact at the COMPONENT level: B, C and D passed, A failed. At the STATISTIC level it is five out of six: Rg, r80, density, winding and profile passed, |C - Y| failed. Both statements are true of the same result; the report used the first.

AMBIGUITY_2_NOTATION.QUESTION: what does the notation 5/4, 4/4, 5/4 mean?
AMBIGUITY_2_NOTATION.SOURCE: OBDI01/code/run_obdi01.py prints '%d/%d' % (v['arms_within'], v['arms_required']) for the D component
AMBIGUITY_2_NOTATION.ANSWER: PASSING_ARMS / REQUIRED_PASSING_ARMS — NOT passing over total
AMBIGUITY_2_NOTATION.WHY_IT_LOOKED_WRONG: a numerator larger than a denominator reads as impossible when the denominator is assumed to be the total. Here the denominator is the REQUIREMENT, so 5/4 means five arms passed where four were required.
AMBIGUITY_2_NOTATION.CAVEAT_AT_L_72: at L = 72 one arm went extinct, so its TV is undefined and it was counted as NOT within the envelope. The component therefore passed exactly at its threshold, 4 of 5 where 4 were required.

PRIMARY_ESTIMAND_RECOVERED.NAME: beta_CY
PRIMARY_ESTIMAND_RECOVERED.DEFINITION: log d_CY(L) = alpha + beta_CY * log L + eps, where d_CY(L) is the arm-level median of |C - Y| DIVIDED BY the operator's exact finite-size prediction at that L. The division is part of the frozen estimand, not a later adjustment.
PRIMARY_ESTIMAND_RECOVERED.FROZEN_CONSTRUCTION: per arm y = log(observed) - log(predicted at that L); the predicted value already contains the exact periodic-image correction, so under H_bound y has NO trend in L, whatever L-independent bias the capacity cap introduces
PRIMARY_ESTIMAND_RECOVERED.C_DEFINITION: C is the toroidal Frechet centre of the X field: the separable exact minimiser of the sum of squared toroidal distances, computed axis by axis, rounded to a lattice site
PRIMARY_ESTIMAND_RECOVERED.Y_DEFINITION: Y is the organiser: the single cell carrying n_Y > 0. With one organiser its position is exact, not an estimate.
PRIMARY_ESTIMAND_RECOVERED.METRIC: |C - Y| is the toroidal Euclidean distance hypot(wdist1(dy, L), wdist1(dx, L)) with wdist1 the wrapped one-dimensional distance
